name: btplatform
description: Boomtown Platform — Cloudflare Worker API, D1 schema, and the static app. Root manifest exists to pin the Wrangler version and give the commands in CLAUDE.md a single entry point. 'type: module' declares what worker/src already is: every module there is ESM, and without it Node reparses each one and warns on every test run that imports index.js. The shipped browser corpus under web/ is classic script and is never loaded by Node — preflight compiles it with vm.Script — so it is unaffected.
